title: How to Build a Winning Video Marketing Strategy in 2026 - Lemonlight

facts.fact: The Lemonlight guide lists six steps for building a video marketing strategy: start with video goals, find the target audience, figure out the story, keep creative requirements in line, stick to the timeline, and maintain a realistic budget.
facts.quote: How to Build a Video Marketing Strategy 1. Start with your video goals. 2. Find your target audience. 3. Figure out what story you want to tell. 4. Keep creative requirements in line. 5. Stick to your timeline. 6. Maintain a realistic budget.

facts.fact: Lemonlight's guide lists four basic framework elements for a video story: protagonist with a goal, conflict, quest, and resolution.
facts.quote: You’ll want to outline the following four elements, which serve as the basic framework of your story.

facts.fact: The Lemonlight guide page was last updated on November 3, 2026.
